name: limited-gauntlet
//dependencies: PI-109: the Prisma 7 client, pg adapter, and CLI are declared here (not only in server/) so npm hoists them to the root node_modules the Docker runtime stage copies. npm's resolver otherwise nests a lone-consumer workspace dep under server/node_modules (the PI-102 de-hoist hazard) — and the container's entrypoint runs ./node_modules/.bin/prisma at boot, so a nested `prisma` CLI = boot failure.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace mcp
